display.speed_note: DAVIS matches frozen public MP420fps; Synthetic uses declared20fps display for its25 timeline samples (raw VideoMatte source-time speed is not asserted).

region_protocol.foreground: reference alpha >= 230/255; DAVIS original mask resized with nearest-neighbor, nonzero foreground
region_protocol.boundary: 3x3 morphological gradient of alpha>=128/255; Euclidean distance to gradient pixels at output resolution
region_protocol.disparity_edge: max absolute 4-neighbor difference of supplied PNG8 disparity >=4 units, dilated with 5x5 ones; reference-defined, not prediction-defined
region_protocol.empty: null metric and zero pixel count; excluded from scene/group means with valid counts reported
region_protocol.scene_aggregation: sum absolute/squared RGB error over all region pixels and frames divided by pixel_count*3; temporal mask is union of adjacent reference regions over24 transitions
region_protocol.cross_scene_aggregation: unweighted scene means and separately unweighted source-group means of scene means; shared-source scenes are not independent replications
region_protocol.synthetic_reference: MPIB-public sRGB proxy GT, not physical paired ground truth
region_protocol.davis_reference: input RGB for modification diagnostics only, not bokeh GT; no motion compensation

A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.other_methods: fixed descriptive panels; never select a per-case winner
A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.synthetic_absolute: global MSE or time-change MAE >= exploration within-K90th percentile
A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.synthetic_local_global_normal: global MSE <= within-K median AND boundary_0_2 MAE >= within-K90th percentile
A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.normal_control: within-K global MSE interquartile range AND boundary MAE <= median; nearest input-proxy match, prefer different source group
A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.davis_candidates: VEPI-public-mp4 <=10th percentile OR <=MPIB-0.02; codec |delta| >=90th percentile reported separately
A_rules_fixed_before_metrics.selection: up to3 candidates/category, prefer distinct source groups; retain full exploration flags; no visual inference
